label: Salah Essentials
description: The core sequence of a single unit (rakah) of prayer, from the opening takbir through the final tashahhud — plus the extra recitations belonging only to the closing rakah of a prayer.

preconditions.title: Purification (Taharah)
preconditions.detail: Perform Wudu (or Ghusl, if required). Salah is not valid without it.

preconditions.title: Clean Body, Clothes & Place
preconditions.detail: Your body, clothing, and the spot you pray on must be free of impurity (najasah).

preconditions.title: Covering the Awrah
preconditions.detail: Men: navel to the knees, with the shoulders preferably covered too. Women: the entire body except the face and hands (some scholars also except the feet).

preconditions.title: Facing the Qiblah
preconditions.detail: Stand facing the direction of the Ka'bah in Makkah.

preconditions.title: Correct Time
preconditions.detail: Each prayer must be performed within its own prescribed window — not before it starts, and not after it ends.

steps.title: Intention (Niyyah)
steps.description: Face the Qibla and form the intention in your heart for the specific prayer you are about to perform. Speaking it aloud, as below, is an optional custom — the example here is for Fajr.
steps.note: Unlike Wudu, forming this intention is a Shart (necessary condition) for Salah in every madhhab — the prayer is invalid without it. Adapt the prayer name to whichever Salah you are performing.
steps.arabic: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ
steps.transliteration: Nawaitu an usalliya lillahi ta'ala salatal-fajri mustaqbilal-qiblah
steps.translation: Maine Allah Ta'ala ke liye, qibla rukh ho kar, Fajr ki namaz padhne ki niyyat ki.

steps.title: Opening Takbir (Takbiratul Ihram)
steps.description: Raise your hands and say the opening takbir, which begins the prayer.
steps.note: Men typically raise their hands to ear level, women to shoulder level. Afterward, fold the hands below the navel or on the chest — practice varies by region within the Hanafi madhhab.

steps.title: Opening Supplication (Istiftah / Sana)
steps.description: Standing (Qiyam), recite the opening supplication silently before beginning recitation.
steps.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
steps.transliteration: Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghairuk
steps.translation: Aey Allah! Tu pak hai aur main teri hamd (tareef) ke saath tasbih karta hoon, tera naam babarkat hai, teri shaan buland hai, aur tere siwa koi ma'bood nahi.

steps.title: Seeking Refuge (Ta'awwudh)
steps.description: Before reciting Al-Fatihah in the first rakah, silently seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan.
steps.note: Recited silently, once, before Al-Fatihah in the first rakah only — not repeated in later rakahs.
steps.translation: Main dhutkare hue shaytan se Allah ki panah maangta hoon.

steps.title: Recite Al-Fatihah
steps.description: Recite Surah Al-Fatihah, which is required in every unit of prayer, followed (in most units) by another passage from the Qur'an.
steps.note: Reciting some portion of the Qur'an in Qiyam is Fard; reciting Al-Fatihah specifically, as done here, is Wajib in the Hanafi madhhab. Shown in the verified Saheeh International English translation rather than a hand-written Urdu rendering, to protect the accuracy of this sacred text.
steps.arabic: بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ ٱهۡدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمَ صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
steps.transliteration: Bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi Alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena Alrrahmani alrraheemi Maliki yawmi alddeeni Iyyaka naAAbudu waiyyaka nastaAAeenu Ihdina alssirata almustaqeema Sirata allatheena anAAamta AAalayhim ghayri almaghdoobi AAalayhim wala alddalleena
steps.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful Sovereign of the Day of Recompense It is You we worship and You we ask for help Guide us to the straight path The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray

steps.title: Recite a Short Surah (e.g. Al-Ikhlas)
steps.description: Recite any surah or a few verses of the Qur'an after Al-Fatihah. Surah Al-Ikhlas is used here as a common example — any surah may be recited instead.
steps.note: Wajib in the Hanafi madhhab in the first two rakahs of a Fard prayer, and in every rakah of Sunnah, Nafl, and Witr prayers. Shown in English for the same reason as Al-Fatihah above.
steps.arabic: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
steps.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun Allahu alssamadu Lam yalid walam yooladu Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun
steps.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One Allah, the Eternal Refuge He neither begets nor is born Nor is there to Him any equivalent

steps.title: Bowing (Ruku)
steps.description: Bow with your back straight and hands resting on your knees, saying the glorification of your Lord three times.
steps.translation: Mera Rab, jo sab se azeem hai, har aib se pak hai.

steps.title: Rising from Ruku (Qawmah)
steps.description: Stand up straight from the bow, saying the praise of Allah.
steps.note: Standing straight here, before Sujood, is itself one of the Fard actions of the prayer — not just a brief pause.
steps.arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ. رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ
steps.transliteration: Sami' Allahu liman hamidah. Rabbana wa lakal hamd, hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih
steps.translation: Allah ne us shakhs ki sun li jisne uski tareef ki. Aey hamare Rab! Sari tareef tere hi liye hai — bohat zyada, pakiza aur barkat wali tareef.

steps.title: Prostration (Sujood)
steps.description: Prostrate with your forehead, nose, palms, knees, and toes touching the ground, saying the glorification of your Lord, the Most High, three times.
steps.translation: Mera Rab, jo sab se buland hai, har aib se pak hai.

steps.title: Sitting Between the Two Prostrations
steps.description: Sit up briefly between the two prostrations, asking for forgiveness, before prostrating a second time (same as the Sujood step above).
steps.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
steps.translation: Aey mere Rab! Mujhe bakhsh de. Aey mere Rab! Mujhe bakhsh de.

steps.title: Tashahhud
steps.description: Sitting after two units — and again at the end of the prayer — recite the tashahhud, testifying to the oneness of Allah and the Prophethood of Muhammad ﷺ.
steps.note: Sitting for at least this long in the final sitting is Fard; reciting the Tashahhud wording, in both sittings, is Wajib. In a prayer of more than 2 rakahs, stand up directly for the next rakah after the first Tashahhud — the Durood and closing dua below belong only to the final sitting.
steps.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَواتُ، وَالطَّيِّباتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ
steps.transliteration: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat. As-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh. As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu al la ilaha illallah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.
steps.translation: Tamam zabani, badani aur maali ibadaten Allah hi ke liye hain. Aey Nabi! Aap par salamati ho, aur Allah ki rahmat aur uski barkaten ho. Hum par aur Allah ke naik bandon par bhi salamati ho. Main gawahi deta hoon keh Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur main gawahi deta hoon keh Muhammad (ﷺ) uske bande aur rasool hain.

steps.title: Salawat Upon the Prophet (Durood-e-Ibrahim)
steps.description: In the final tashahhud only, send blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, as taught in the Sunnah.
steps.note: Recited only in the final sitting, after the Tashahhud.
steps.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
steps.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala aali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidum-Majeed. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala aali Muhammadin, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala aali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidum-Majeed.
steps.translation: Aey Allah! Muhammad (ﷺ) aur unki aal par rahmat nazil farma, jaise tune Ibrahim (AS) aur unki aal par rahmat nazil farmayi — be-shak tu qabil-e-tareef aur bulandi wala hai. Aey Allah! Muhammad (ﷺ) aur unki aal par barkat nazil farma, jaise tune Ibrahim (AS) aur unki aal par barkat nazil farmayi — be-shak tu qabil-e-tareef aur bulandi wala hai.

steps.title: Closing Dua — Seeking Refuge
steps.description: After the Durood, before Taslim, it is Sunnah to seek refuge in Allah from four trials.
steps.note: Narrated in Sahih Muslim (Prophet ﷺ taught this to be recited between the final Tashahhud/Durood and Taslim).
steps.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
steps.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam, wa min 'adhabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal
steps.translation: Aey Allah! Main jahannam ke azaab se, qabar ke azaab se, zindagi aur maut ke fitnon se, aur Dajjal ke fitne ki buraai se teri panah maangta hoon.

steps.title: Ending the Prayer (Taslim)
steps.description: Turn your head to the right, then to the left, saying the closing greeting to end the prayer.
steps.note: Turning to the right and saying this once is Wajib; turning to the left and repeating it is Sunnah.
steps.translation: Aap par Allah ka salam aur uski rahmat ho.
